# Taskfile: support verbose mode

Add a `verbose` switch to the Taskfile convention ([[DOT-141]]):

```bash
$ run verbose some-command
```

— run the task with command echo (`set -x`) or with the suppression removed, mirroring the `verbose` target of the repository's [Makefile](../../Makefile), where `make verbose install` clears the `@` prefix through `$(eval AT :=)`.
